title: MRO MARS HIGH RESOLUTION IMAGING SCIENCE EXPERIMENT DTM V1.0
description: Digital Terrain Models (DTMs) of Mars produced from stereo pairs of HiRISE observations using photogrammetric stereo-matching, each accompanied by one or more orthorectified images draped on it.

(2008), Ultrahigh resolution topographic mapping of Mars with MRO HiRISE stereo images: Meter-scale slopes of candidate Phoenix landing sites, Journal of Geophysical Research, 113, E00A24, doi:10.1029/2007JE003000.
